name: Honour of the Duel
body:
You strongly believe in 1-on-1 combat to decide a fight.

Prerequisite: Good or Lawful Alignment

Effect: DC 10 + your character level Will save to attack a creature in a square threatened by another of it’s foes. -2 on attack rolls if you succeed. Action wasted if failed.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
